headline: Fagnano Gets the Ball, Brissett Gets a Hotel Room, and the Ravens Still Get Ten
text:
Thursday morning conference call, one game on the board tonight.

Baltimore's Brissett trade is next week, not tonight. Joe Fagnano still starts. All four scoring cards stick with Ravens +10 and Over 39.5. Follow The Money still no call.

The number is still Jacksonville −10, total 39.5. Zero flips. Inactives next. Unmute.
